headline: JPMorgan brings its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum

scenes.vo: America's biggest bank just put its own dollar token on Ethereum's main network. Here's what changed.
JPMorgan's blockchain unit, Kinexys, says JPM Coin is now live on Ethereum for institutional clients. Each token stands for a real dollar deposit at the bank.
Here's why traders are watching it. Clients can now send these dollars to each other directly, on Ethereum and on Base, any time of day.
The catch. This is for big institutions only, not everyday users, and it doesn't change the price of ether on its own.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether more banks follow JPMorgan onto public chains, and how much real money moves through JPM Coin.
